design_brief: Larger late-office object; doorway, interior and glass front must remain independently occludable.
gameplay_scope: Art and future layout proposal only; no new hiring, role behavior, tool authority, transaction or interaction is implemented.

current_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.

variants.redraw_requirement: Draw the actual north service front; operator approaches that side looking south. Fixed screen floor axes and upper-left light; do not rotate or mirror finished raster art. No implemented interaction is implied.
variants.reason: Independent native v1 visual review fails: roof framed as an upright panel produces a stacked-cabinet silhouette. Scores3/1/2/3/2/3, mean2.33. Corrected fixture functional total231/0 is not visual approval. Separatev2 cap/elevation correction in progress, no runtime binding.

review.note: V1 visual failure despite passing collision and native registration. Roof/elevation visual hierarchy must be corrected; no score threshold weakened.
